codeHints.LAUNCHER_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: Launcher database (launcher-v2.sqlite) is unreadable or missing. Please browse and select a valid database file.
codeHints.SAVE_UNAVAILABLE: Specified save file does not exist or lacks read permission. Please refresh the save library or reselect a save.
codeHints.SAVE_CONTAINER_CORRUPT: Save container or internal gamestate structure is corrupt. Please try another save.
codeHints.UNSUPPORTED_BINARY_SAVE: Ironman or binary saves cannot be parsed. DTT only supports non-ironman text saves.
codeHints.PLAYER_COUNTRY_MISSING: No player-controlled empire was found in this save file. Please confirm if this is a player save.
codeHints.PLAYER_COUNTRY_REQUIRED: Multiple player empires found in save. Please select an empire in the Empire card.
codeHints.GENERATION_BUSY: A generation task is already running. Please wait or cancel the active task before starting a new one.
codeHints.GENERATION_CANCELLED: Generation task was cancelled per user request.
codeHints.INTERNAL: An internal error occurred. You can expand the technical details below when reporting this issue.
codeHints.MISSING_SETTING: A required environment setting is missing. Select the game directory, documents directory, and launcher database.
codeHints.INVALID_PATH: The selected path is unavailable or has the wrong type. Check the environment paths.
codeHints.NO_OUTPUT_LANGUAGE: Select at least one game output language.
codeHints.EXECUTABLE_PATH_UNAVAILABLE: The executable location could not be determined. Check the application installation.
codeHints.NO_TECHNOLOGY_DEFINITIONS: No technologies were loaded from common/technology. Check the game directory and active MODs.
